title: PH Origins
style: Grounded, cinematic corporate thriller look: one night in Hawkes Tower, cool artificial light, deep shadows, rain-wet city.
notes: Babylon.js game, GLB-only runtime (phoriginswebsite/AGENTS.md). Materials: generate seamless, then texture.maps or image.normals/image.albedo, then compress into assets/textures. Lore for signs and screens: Hawkes Biomedical, Voss Capital, Liberty Square, Midnight Diner. Never show B3, the vat or the creature on public-facing Hawkes signage.

material.description: A tileable material (walnut, lab tile, painted block...) for the interior kit.
material.prompt: Seamless tileable texture: {prompt}. Flat, straight-on, evenly lit, no shadows, no objects, photographic detail.

sign.description: A poster, ad, store sign or document for the world (Hawkes Biomedical, Voss Capital...).
sign.prompt: {prompt}. Flat, front-on, fills the frame, legible typography, {style}

sky.description: A 360° sky / city panorama for a level's skybox.

screen-loop.description: A short loop for a screen (boardroom TV, station ad, CCTV): give the screen's still as start and end.

prop.description: A textured GLB prop from a reference image (convert/compress before shipping).

bark.description: Pierce's inner-voice barks for a room, written to the story's tone.
bark.prompt: Write short inner-voice barks for Pierce Hawkes (chairman of Hawkes Biomedical, one night in Hawkes Tower) for this moment: {prompt}. Terse, dry, in character. Never mention game mechanics.
